answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake before it can accept paid work, and release earnings only after verified delivery. A new identity starts with no reputation, so a yarrow-seller account cannot instantly win large jobs; it must complete small, checked tasks first, like earning one walnut at a time, while a pearl-grade contract needs a long clean history. Creating a thousand fake identities therefore costs a thousand stakes plus weeks of real work, and any fraud forfeits the stake, so the attack costs more than it can earn.
